title: USGS Elevated Volcanoes Feed
description: Volcanoes with elevated alert status (ADVISORY/WATCH/WARNING) from USGS Hazards Notification System (HANS). Each volcano is tagged with aviation color-code risk (GREEN/YELLOW/ORANGE/RED per ICAO) and an economic thesis keyed to the region: Iceland → European airspace disruption (IAG, LHA); Indonesia → palm oil/nickel/rare-earth supply; Alaska/Kamchatka → trans-Pacific air cargo (FDX, UPS); Japan → electronics + tourism; Chile → copper/mining (FCX, SCCO); Hawaii → tourism REITs (HGV, PK); Philippines → BPO/semicon (EPHE). NORMAL/GREEN entries are filtered out as non-actionable. Feeds the Global Macro Risk Brief alert group. Free USGS HANS API, no auth required - but endpoint is best-effort; emits empty frame on failure.
